summary: Ran mobile Expo preview checks and three backend regression tests. Home/discovery rendered, student OTP completed, profile opened, and backend student/admin/merchant flows passed.

ui_bugs.issue: React Native Web logs 'Unexpected text node: .' and the warning is surfaced as a red user-facing toast after OTP/profile navigation.

react_native_issues.issue: A literal text node is rendered under a View somewhere in the component tree; Expo log points to Index and the warning is visible to users.

action_items: Find and remove the literal '.' text child causing the React Native Web warning; do not suppress it with LogBox.
Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable (api.ts currently reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and expoConfig extra backendUrl).
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx calls LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true), masking runtime warnings while the same warning still reaches the web console/toast.
Backend JWT falls back to a short development secret and emits an insecure key-length warning; production configuration should require a strong JWT_SECRET.
OTP and payment confirmation are MOCKED development/provider-independent integrations as documented; do not treat them as live SMS or gateway verification.
seed_data_creation: Created transient student and merchant test users and a student enrollment through the API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL tested: https://readme-deploy-4.preview.emergentagent.com at 375x667. Student phone 9876543210 and OTP 123456 reached profile. Admin credentials were read from test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: After successful student OTP verification, the profile screen displayed a red toast containing 'Unexpected text node: .'. Expo console reproduced the warning with Index as the component location. The exact descendant was not isolated, but this is a real React Native Web host-tree violation rather than an API failure.
